in_marathi.name: Rishab
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Axle or the Ruler of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rishabh is derived from the Sanskrit root 'rish' which means 'to rule'. He is considered to be the first king and the first deity in the universe. He is also known as the god of the mountains and the lord of the earth. The name Rishabh signifies power, wisdom, and leadership.
